messages:
Nora B.: Heads-up: need a 1-page "Deploy Fit" one-pager for AE handoff. Scope: security controls (VPC / KMS / HSM / audit logs), SLA tiers by deploy mode, a compact bench snapshot, a tiny deploy-decision flow, inbound routing rules, and a webinar blurb. Deadline: Wed EOD. Who can own copy + routing?

Lucas V.: I can own copy. Will do hero + 3 bullets + footer CTA + micro-decision flow. Need bench numbers and one anonymized quote.

Irene P.: Quick benches (rounded for brief):
```benchmarks
hosted-7b: p50=110ms, p95=300ms, est $/kTokens=8
dedicated-7b-quant: p50=50ms, p95=120ms, est $/kTokens=5
private-vpc (typical customer infra): p50=35-180ms, est $/kTokens=varies
```

Zack M.: Routing rules (HubSpot snippets):
- if industry in [finance, healthcare, gov] OR employee_count>1000 -> route to AE-enterprise
- if compliance_checkbox includes any of [HIPAA, FedRAMP, SOC2] -> route to SE-security
- if deployment_interest==Private AND compliance==true -> auto-schedule SE 30m
- else -> SDR + autoresponder with one-pager attached
Also add contact tag: secure-deploy-lead.

DevAnn Bot: Layout rec: hero + three columns (Security | SLA & Latency | Deployment Fit) + bench callout card. Decision flow: small 3-box row -> Hosted (fast start) / Dedicated (predictable throughput) / Private (compliance & isolation). Footer: webinar CTA "Secure Serving Playbook" + register link.

Irene P.: Add footnote: "Benchmarks measured on Redwood fleets with ~2s prompt; customer workloads and network topology will affect latency."

LegalBot: Please include brief: "Customers requiring data residency or contractual encryption-in-use terms should engage Sales for DPA/contract addendums."

Lucas V.: Draft will be posted Tue noon in channel (copy-only). Will include suggested micro-CTAs: Request brief | Schedule SLA review | Join webinar.

Nora B.: Perfect. Action owners: Lucas (copy), DevAnn (layout), Irene (final benches), Zack (routing rules implementation), LegalBot (contractual blurb). I'll collate and publish Thu AM and set webinar invite for next Wed. Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
